Health documents for a rabbit and a reptile

Traveling with a companion animal can be calm, organized, and reassuring when you have the right documents prepared before you arrive at the skyport. The Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways helps passengers coordinate safe, humane procedures with trained handlers across routes between skyports.

For rabbits, health certificates support smooth entry and transport planning. The health certificate for a rabbit stays valid for 41 days after issuance, helping ensure your travel window remains covered without last-minute document stress. A rabbit health certificate stays valid for 41 days, meaning it remains acceptable for travel within that period.

For reptiles, document readiness is also closely tied to age requirements. Aurelia Skyways coordinators work with you to confirm eligibility so your animal can travel under the applicable rules. A reptile may travel at the minimum age of 11 weeks, meaning it can accompany you once it reaches that earliest allowed developmental stage.

When you contact CATD, share your itinerary and the type of companion animal so the team can guide you through what to bring and how to present it at check-in. Staff prioritize calm handling and humane methods, and you can remain present during coordination when appropriate.

If you have questions about validity dates, minimum travel age, or acceptable paperwork formats, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways for personalized assistance. More guidance is available at the Companion Animal Travel Desk help channel.
